turnaround_reason: Fox Factory (premium ride-dynamics products across bikes, powersports/off-road, and aftermarket applications) was crushed by a bike-channel inventory glut, weak discretionary demand, and tariff-driven margin compression. The turnaround is now visibly underway: Q2 2026 beat on EBITDA, management raised the full-year sales view, and Powersports grew ~22.5% YoY with a mapped margin recovery into 2H.
bullish_points: Q2 2026 EBITDA beat (~$5M) and a raised full-year 2026 sales outlook — a real inflection, not just hope
Powered Vehicles / Powersports surged +22.5% YoY in Q2 (+28% 1H), the clear bright spot
Clear margin recovery path guided: ~12.2% Q2 EBITDA margin stepping to ~13.6% Q3 and ~15.6% Q4 as tariffs anniversary and cost savings land
Bike stabilizing: expected roughly flat with strong margins, and new e-bike products reportedly sold out
Strong price momentum confirms the 'recovering' mode (+26.7% over 30 days, well above 200-day MA)
bearish_points: Stock has already run hard (+26.7% in 30 days; ~122% of its 100-day MA) — much of the near-term recovery may be priced in
TTM GAAP profitability is deeply negative (profit margin ~-20%), reflecting prior write-downs and weak volumes
Gross margins compressed on unmitigated tariffs plus steel/aluminum inflation; the 2H margin ramp is a guide, not a fact
Small cap (~$915M) with ~$680M debt; discretionary end-markets (bikes, off-road) remain consumer-sensitive
Options are illiquid (call OI ~76), so this is effectively a spot-only expression
catalyst: Q3/Q4 2026 margin step-up as tariffs anniversary, cost-savings phase 2 lands, and PVG recovers on easing F-150 chassis supply
suggested_trade: Spot position, but wait for a pullback given the sharp run; scale in on dips toward the 100-day MA
key_risk: Discretionary demand (bike channel) re-breaks down or tariff drag persists, and the guided 2H margin ramp fails to materialize
would_skip_if: Bike channel inventory worsens again or Q3 margins fail to step up as guided; would pass on chasing further strength without a pullback
